name: ew-ai-resource-governor
description: Examine AI resources, diagnose work needs, and prescribe a model and reasoning level for the user to choose. / 檢查 AI 資源、診斷工作需求並提出模型與推理強度處方，由使用者選擇。

interface.displayName: EW AI Resource Governor / 具象 AI 資源治理
interface.shortDescription: AI resource diagnosis and responsible prescriptions. / AI 資源診斷與負責任的處方。
interface.longDescription: Acts like an AI resource doctor: examines available allowance, diagnoses what the work deserves under business policy, and prescribes a suitable model, reasoning level, and work policy with clear tradeoffs. It automatically provides diagnosis and prescription, but never performs treatment by changing the user's settings. / 如同 AI 資源醫生：檢查可用額度，依企業政策診斷工作值得投入多少資源，並提出模型、推理強度與工作策略處方及其取捨。它自動提供診斷與處方，但絕不替使用者變更設定或強制治療。
interface.developerName: Embodied Worker Co., Ltd. / 具象職人股份有限公司
defaultPrompt: Optimize my AI resource use for this task. / 幫我最佳化這項工作的 AI 資源使用。
Decide how much AI resource this work deserves. / 判斷這項工作值得多少 AI 資源。
Classify this task and recommend a work policy. / 為這項任務分級並建議工作策略。
Inventory my resources and recommend the right model for this work. / 盤點我的資源並建議這項工作適合的模型。
